cards.card_text: Jacob says, “Swear to me first,” so Esau swears to Jacob and sells him the birthright.

cards.card_text: Esau sells his birthright for one meal, then eats, drinks, gets up and goes away.
“Thus Esau despised his birthright.” Friend, that's trading the WHOLE bakery for one warm cookie.
